workflow.title: Stop paying AI to rediscover what you already know.
workflow.subtitle1: Autonomous agentic loops are great for exploring new idea.
workflow.subtitle2: Frugäast is for maintaining your (large) codebase.

cleanCode.title: Exceptionally clean code.
cleanCode.para1_1: Your LLM has a 200k context window. Cool.

philosophy.para1: You already know what you want. You don't need an AI to take over—you just need it to execute what you have in mind.
philosophy.para2: Frugäast shines on large, complex codebases where you need to keep control.
